integrity: The general proof is symbolic. A standalone exact checker exhausts all 4,474 labeled posets on at most five points, verifies the L-algebra axioms, classifies the prime ideals, and reconstructs the topology.
scientific_limitations: The realization theorem is finite; no infinite-space analogue is claimed.
The n+1 element construction is not claimed to be size-minimal or unique.
The originality search cannot exclude uncatalogued folklore or an equivalent observation under different terminology.
title: Every finite T0 space is an L-algebra prime spectrum
